changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Migrate stage and lead context from n_lead_tasks into n_tasks.task_details (entityId, entityType LEAD, stageKey and other details)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE n_tasks t SET task_details = ( jsonb_build_object('entityId', l.lead_identifier, 'entityType', 'LEAD') || COALESCE(lt.task_details, '{}'::jsonb) ) FROM n_lead_tasks lt JOIN n_lead l ON lt.lead_id = l.id WHERE t.id = lt.task_id
